nodes.rationale: The header is ignored on unkeyed requests, so a browser cannot rotate it to get a fresh rate-limit bucket.

nodes.label: React Compiler annotation mode
nodes.rationale: Only files that opt in are compiled, because the compiler pays off measurably only on a few hot files. The compiler does not make an effect correct, fix a missing key, or fix a useMemo dependency, so those stay manual.

nodes.label: API key (server-only secret)
nodes.rationale: Anyone who can load the page can read a key held in browser code, so keys stay on the server and the server adds them.

nodes.label: Avoid Styling Overengineering
nodes.rationale: No custom utilities Tailwind already provides, no duplicate tokens, no abstraction layers for simple UI; the simplest maintainable solution wins.

nodes.label: Existing Project Compatibility
nodes.rationale: Existing CSS and Tailwind implementations are not replaced merely because another approach is preferred; changes reduce churn.

nodes.label: Tailwind-First Styling Principle
nodes.rationale: Tailwind expresses layout, spacing, typography, states and theme utilities most clearly; standard CSS is reserved for keyframes, advanced selectors, third-party overrides and dynamic custom properties.

nodes.label: Idle DB connections close after 60 seconds
nodes.norm_label: idle db connections close after 60 seconds
nodes.rationale: Idle connections held Postgres backends open on Neon, so the compute never slept between requests.

nodes.label: Framework-Free Client API
nodes.rationale: Every widget subpath depends on the client at runtime, which is why all four frameworks ship inside one package and share its version.

nodes.label: renderMarkdown / safeUrl
nodes.rationale: Raw HTML is stripped and links are restricted to http(s) and mailto, so a comment body cannot inject markup or javascript: URLs.

nodes.label: Thread Window Paging Helpers
nodes.rationale: The API returns no total, so listCommentsPage probes one extra row for hasMore and loadThreadWindow accumulates rows until N whole threads exist.

nodes.label: Skeleton Loading States
nodes.rationale: Skeletons replace blank space, and the identity control shows a skeleton chip until get-session answers, so a comment can never be posted with a guessed identity.

nodes.label: Measured Thread Guide Lines
nodes.rationale: Each thread's guide is its own subpath so it never connects to the thread above, and lines ride the gutter midpoint so they never cross comment content.

nodes.label: Thread-Based Paging
nodes.rationale: Lists page through threads; the list endpoint returns no total and rows are fetched only for the visited page and kept in memory, so Previous is instant and never re-requests.

nodes.rationale: The stack boots without PAYLOAD_SECRET, BETTER_AUTH_SECRET, DATABASE_URL or BUSINESS_DATABASE_URL, so the workflow fails early when any is unset.

nodes.label: Admin CSS Real <link> Contract
nodes.rationale: RSC-injected styles do not exist on first paint, so the admin stylesheet must arrive as a real <link>.

nodes.label: migrate:create Value-Import Trap
nodes.rationale: The CLI emits MigrateUpArgs/MigrateDownArgs as value imports, which crashes migrate with 'does not provide an export named MigrateDownArgs'.

nodes.label: payloadParseSearch / payloadStringifySearch
nodes.rationale: TanStack's default serializer JSON-quotes values (?depth="1") and Payload ignores them, so admin pagination silently stops working.

nodes.label: handleServerFunctions RSC Passthrough
nodes.rationale: Re-wrapping in toSerializable strips RSC elements ($$typeof is a Symbol) and hangs relationship drawers and form state on a spinner.

nodes.label: withPayloadRoot Admin Shell
nodes.rationale: Wrapping __root with withPayloadRoot hands <html> to Payload's shell on /admin so data-theme/dir/lang rules match; a hand-rolled shell leaves ~60 admin rules unmatchable.

nodes.label: TanStack Start / Payload Boot Contract
nodes.rationale: The vite plugin order is load-bearing: the default RSC server handler 500s every request and the full payloadPlugin wrapper 404s every route on this TanStack line, so serverHandler:false and the vendored subset exist instead of a 'simpler' config.

nodes.label: Framework peer dependencies
nodes.rationale: Other frameworks' libraries are optional peers and are never installed; only the chosen framework is a peer dependency.

nodes.label: Raw HTML stripped, links restricted to http, https and mailto
nodes.norm_label: raw html stripped, links restricted to http, https and mailto

nodes.label: Dark Mode Through The Same Tokens
nodes.norm_label: dark mode through the same tokens
nodes.rationale: A component should adapt to theme changes without implementation changes, so dark mode redefines token values rather than adding per-component dark: overrides.

nodes.label: Semantic Design Token Palette
nodes.rationale: Theme colours are centrally managed semantic tokens so no component hardcodes a brand colour and light/dark share one definition.

nodes.label: shadcn Registry Primitives
nodes.rationale: Reusable UI primitives come from the registry (base-nova, neutral, lucide) as the concrete form of the prefer-reusable-primitives rule; components are owned source, never docs copy-paste.

nodes.label: Status Colour Semantics
nodes.rationale: Colour communicates purpose, never decoration: neutral surfaces first, strong semantic colours only for meaningful actions and states.
